text:
support_jordan: customer (acct 3321, enterprise) says their A/B experiment page is showing ~90/10 instead of configured 50/50. link: https://console.redwood.ai/experiments/exp_a9b2c3 — they said this began ~11:06 UTC after a deploy. billing team escalated. :(

analytics_owen: pulling assignment stream counts now (kafka topic assignments_v2). will paste quick counts

analytics_owen: quick counts from assignments_v2 for exp_a9b2c3 (11:00-12:00 UTC):
```
variant_id | cnt
control     | 49,823
treatment   | 50,177
```
so allocator assignments look ~50/50. dashboard rendering is off.

infra_maya: any recent releases to allocator/labeling or metrics-ingest?

release-bot: deployment: allocator-service rolled: commit d4e5f6g by eng_lee at 2026-04-02T11:05:12Z. note: "allocator: support label tagging for multi-namespace"

eng_lee: that commit introduces a namespacing tag appended to labels (format: label+ns). intended to help multi-tenant labeling. i tested locally but maybe ETL wasn't covered. i'll look.

analytics_owen: looking at metrics-ingest join: we join events.variant_label -> experiment_variants.label to resolve variant_id. events now show labels like "control+ns1"/"treatment+ns1" so join fails -> events get routed to "unknown" group in dashboard aggregator. the dashboard UI then displays unknown as the primary variant (index 0) and shows the other variant counts separately, producing the apparent 90/10.

support_jordan: customer timeline matches deploy: they saw shift at ~11:07.

pm_irene: severity = P1 (billing + exec visibility). recommended mitigation?

eng_lee: options: 1) rollback allocator (fast and restores prior label format) 2) patch metrics-ingest to strip +ns suffix before join (deployable quickly) 3) backfill events to map labels to canonical ones.

analytics_owen: prefer patching ingest + backfill to avoid churn. i can prepare a quick transform that normalizes labels using regexp_replace(label, '\\+.*$', '') then run backfill for the 11:05-11:15 window.

infra_maya: how fast can we get ingest patch out?

eng_lee: i can push a minimal change to allocator to also emit a canonical_label field in events so ingest doesn't need to rely on label string. but that takes longer. for hotfix i'll approve ingest patch.

eng_lee: deploy-bot: please queue patch to metrics-ingest with commit patch/strip-labels.

release-bot: deployment started: metrics-ingest patch/strip-labels -> rolling 4 nodes at 2026-04-02T11:12:30Z

analytics_owen: deployed. running a dry normalization on staging and then running a backfill script against prod for 2026-04-02T11:05:00->2026-04-02T11:20:00. dry-run SQL: 
```
SELECT regexp_replace(variant_label, '\\+.*$', '') as canonical, count(*)
FROM raw_events
WHERE experiment_id='exp_a9b2c3' AND event_time >= '2026-04-02T11:05:00' AND event_time <= '2026-04-02T11:20:00'
GROUP BY 1;
```

analytics_owen: dry-run shows canonical counts mapping to control/treatment ~50/50. kicking off backfill now. est runtime ~6m for ~80k events.

eng_lee: monitoring deploy logs, looks good.

analytics_owen: backfill finished at 2026-04-02T11:19:58Z. patched ~79,982 events. post-backfill dashboard aggregation query: 
```
SELECT display_label, SUM(cnt) from dashboard_rollup WHERE experiment_id='exp_a9b2c3' GROUP BY 1;
-- control: 40012, treatment: 39970
```
dashboard now shows ~50/50.

support_jordan: informed customer, they confirmed dashboard reads correctly. they appreciated the proactive follow-up.

pm_irene: follow-ups / action items:
- eng_lee: implement canonical_label emission in allocator + add integration test that validates metrics-ingest joins (due EOD)
- analytics_owen: add ETL alert: if >0.5% of events for an experiment are unresolved/\"unknown\" for 5m window, fire pager (due tomorrow)
- infra_maya: run a quick audit of recent deploys that touched labeling schemas (due today)

eng_lee: PR to allocator to emit canonical_label opened: https://github.com/redwood/allocator/pull/834

analytics_owen: ticket created METRICS-612 for unknown-bucket alerting and METRICS-613 for backfill tooling improvements

support_jordan: closing this case with customer. will reopen if anything else crops up.
